fullPassage: Hipparchus of Nicaea was the most important astronomer of the Hellenistic Age after Aristarchus of Samos. Unlike Aristarchus, Hipparchus believed in the geocentric universe of Aristotle. A noted mathematician, Hipparchus gauged the movement of the sun and the moon using an astronomical model devised by Apollonius of Perga. Hipparchus worked at Alexandria and Rhodes; at the latter city, he created a kind of astronomical research center in which he cataloged the stars according to brightness. He produced a star chart of about 850 stars, tracking their movements and relative brightness. Hipparchus made more accurate measurements than Aristarchus did of the distance of the moon and sun from the earth. To account for the orbit of the sun around the earth he developed the idea of the eccentric, which Ptolemy of Alexandria would expand upon.

det.korean: 지구를 우주의 중심에 두는 이론 = geocentric(지구 중심설).
det.analysis:
① astronomical — 천문학적인 (형용사)
② heliocentric — 태양 중심설
③ eccentric — 이심원, 또는 별난
④ geocentric ←정답 — geo-(지구) + centric(중심의). 지구 중심설
det.tip: geo = Earth, helio = Sun. geocentric ↔ heliocentric.

questions.passage: Hipparchus worked at Alexandria and Rhodes; at the latter city, he __________ (create) a kind of astronomical research center.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 히파르코스가 로도스에서 천문학 연구 센터를 만들었다. 과거 시제로 변환.
det.analysis: 주어 he + 과거 시제 문맥(worked) → create의 과거형 created.
det.tip: 과거 사실 서술이므로 단순 과거 시제(created) 사용.

questions.passage: A noted mathematician, Hipparchus gauged the movement of the sun and the moon using an astronomical model __________ (devise) by Apollonius of Perga.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 아폴로니우스에 의해 고안된 모델 → 수동 의미의 과거분사(devised).
det.analysis: model __________ by Apollonius → 명사를 뒤에서 수식하는 과거분사. devise → devised.
det.tip: 명사 + p.p. + by = 수동 분사구. 'devised by' = 고안된.

questions.passage: Hipparchus of Nicaea was the most important astronomer of the Hellenistic Age after Aristarchus of Samos. Unlike Aristarchus, Hipparchus believed in the geocentric universe of Aristotle. A noted mathematician, Hipparchus gauged the movement of the sun and the moon using an astronomical model devised by Apollonius of Perga. Hipparchus worked at Alexandria and Rhodes; at the latter city, he created a kind of astronomical research center in which he cataloged the stars according to brightness. He produced a star chart of about 850 stars, tracking their movements and relative brightness. Hipparchus made more accurate measurements than Aristarchus did of the distance of the moon and sun from the earth. To __________ the orbit of the sun around the earth he developed the idea of the eccentric, which Ptolemy of Alexandria would expand upon.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 태양 공전 궤도를 '설명하기' 위해 이심원 개념을 개발했다. = account for.
det.analysis:
① approve of — 승인하다. 부적절
② account for ←정답 — '~을 설명하다'. 태양 궤도를 설명하기 위해 이심원 개념 개발
③ abstain from — 삼가다. 부적절
④ result in — 결과를 낳다. 인과 방향이 반대
det.tip: account for = explain. 학문적 글에서 자주 등장.

questions.passage: Hipparchus of Nicaea was the most important astronomer of the Hellenistic Age after Aristarchus of Samos. Unlike Aristarchus, Hipparchus believed in the geocentric universe of Aristotle. A noted mathematician, Hipparchus gauged the movement of the sun and the moon using an astronomical model devised by Apollonius of Perga. Hipparchus worked at Alexandria and Rhodes; at the latter city, he created a kind of astronomical research center in which he cataloged the stars according to brightness. He produced a star chart of about 850 stars, tracking their movements and __________. Hipparchus made more accurate measurements than Aristarchus did of the distance of the moon and sun from the earth. To account for the orbit of the sun around the earth he developed the idea of the eccentric, which Ptolemy of Alexandria would expand upon.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 히파르코스는 별의 움직임과 '상대적 밝기'를 추적했다.
det.analysis:
① absolute distance — 절대 거리, 추적 내용 아님
② random patterns — 무작위 패턴, 부적절
③ relative brightness ←정답 — 본문에서 tracking their movements and relative brightness라고 명시
④ total number — 별의 총 개수(약 850개)는 언급됐으나 '추적' 대상 아님
det.tip: relative brightness = 상대적 밝기. 별의 밝기를 다른 별과 비교하는 개념.
